answer.summary: The change routes empty ManuallySuppressedIssues/CurrentIssues through XMLStreamWriter.writeEmptyElement. IndentingXMLStreamWriter already overrides writeEmptyElement(localName) so pretty-printing should work, but one existing test will fail: BaselineResultMappingSpec.`creates on top of an existing a baseline file without issues` asserts the literal `<CurrentIssues></CurrentIssues>` and must be updated to the self-closing form. No existing test covers an empty ManuallySuppressedIssues section or the empty/empty baseline; consider extending BaselineFormatSpec round-trip tests. The public BaselineProvider.write contract (consumed via ServiceLoader by CLI/Gradle) will emit different bytes for empty sections; downstream golden-file tests outside detekt-core were not checked.
